title: 第九章 穿越菜鸟想家了第十章 盛大的婚礼
content_zh:
最新网址：开学前几天，王跃赶回宿舍的时候，宿舍兄弟们都在，一边忙自个的，一边唠嗑。
老大黄涛有点感慨，“我觉得这个暑假，过得那是相当充实。”
其他兄弟也纷纷叹息着，老二接话道，“以前不工作的时候，只是觉得上班有什么累的，特别不理解，结果这个暑假一个月多点工作，还是肖奈这种宽松的初创公司，也让人累的够呛。”
乖孩子老四也说道，“就一个月，我就感觉挺累的，也不知道爸妈他们工作这么多年，是怎么坚持的。”
王跃听着他们的议论，忍不住心里嘀咕，还不是为了生活吗？可生活又是为了什么？穿越前自己咸鱼了接近十年，也没弄明白为什么。
这个咸鱼影视穿越系统大概就是为了让我这样的咸鱼翻下身，躺的太平了，老天就看不惯了。
“这离开学也没几天了，要不，咱们出去喝一杯，咱们有多久没一起去撸串喝酒啦！”王跃这边正放飞思想呢，就听到老二贾红海去突然一拍床铺，吸引了大伙的注意后，说出了自己的想法。
“好嘞，就去ko那家饭店，我去，ko不在那家了，他们的饭还行吗？”老四这边立马跟进。
“那就换一家！”老大皱眉沉思，可还是没想明白哪里好。
“我问问郝眉哥！”老四刘伟想法一向简单，操起手机，就给郝眉拨打了过去。
王跃看到他竟然把电话打给郝眉，就知道，这次没准会办成公司聚餐，于是，他也连忙拿出手机，约上了二喜。
毕竟，肖奈虽然腹黑，但是他很会做人。毕竟这个狐狸装人装了这么多年，早成精了。
果然，不一会刘伟乐呵呵的说郝眉他们也要一起聚餐，已经在大学城附近的一个酒店定了一个包厢，据说包厢名字肖奈很满意，叫青云阁。
一行人赶到酒店，当王跃看到青云阁对门的包厢名字，嘴角不自觉的抽了抽，立刻明白了为啥肖奈也会到了，这又让王跃学到了，这招顺势而为玩的精妙，想来微微都不会觉得有啥不对。
一开始王跃还以为，肖奈会让郝眉付账，自己就不来了呢，结果他低估了肖奈同学的腹黑程度，和护食的决心。
进到包厢内后，在等人的功夫，老四刘伟和和老大他们在讨论着对面就菊轩。
王跃过去坐下，就听到老四还在给老大详细的回报自己的千里耳所得。
“老大。我刚听到对面是帝都风云服务器一个帮会线下聚会。”老四刘伟小声的给黄涛和贾红海说，好像恐怕对面的人听到似的。
“那个帮会的？”老二贾红海。
“好像听到那个第一美人，小雨妖妖！”老四这边刚把这句说完，那边郝眉听到小雨妖妖四个字，立马兴奋了。

“小雨妖妖怎么啦！我好久没有上游戏了，有啥新情况？”
“小雨妖妖又挑衅三嫂了？”
“……”
屋子里几个提前到的，都挺兴奋的，毕竟游戏里的第一美女，不过那是照片，真实情况是啥。
“对面是倩女幽魂线下聚会，我听到有一个声说小雨妖妖。”刘伟一看这情况，也就把自己知道的情况都说了。
“我去听听！”于半珊一听这情况，就打开门，准备去听听。结果一打开门，就看到肖奈正准备打开对面的门！
“老三，看不出来，你是这样的老三，你已经有微微师妹了！就别沾花惹草了。”郝眉跟在于半珊的身后，一副恨铁不成钢的表情。
content_en:
Latest website: A few days before school started, when Wang Yue rushed back to his dormitory, his brothers in the dormitory were all there, chatting while busy with their own tasks.
The boss Huang Tao said with emotion, "I think this summer vacation has been quite fulfilling."
The other brothers also sighed, and the second brother answered, "When I didn't work in the past, I just felt that working was tiring, and I couldn't understand it. As a result, I have to work for more than a month this summer, and it is still a loose start-up company like Xiao Nai. It is also very tiring."
The good boy, the fourth child, also said, "I feel very tired after just one month. I don't know how my parents persisted after working for so many years."
Wang Yue listened to their discussion and couldn't help but mutter in his heart, isn't it just for living? But what is life for? Before time travel, I had been doing nothing for nearly ten years, and I didn’t understand why.
This salty fish film and television time travel system is probably designed to allow salty fish like me to turn over and lie down so flat that God will not tolerate it.
"It's only a few days until school starts. How about we go out for a drink? It's been a long time since we went to have a drink together!" Wang Yue was just letting his thoughts wander when he heard the second child, Jia Honghai, suddenly patted the bed, attracting everyone's attention, and then expressed his thoughts.
"Okay, let's go to KO's restaurant. I'll go. KO is no longer there. Is their food okay?" Lao Si immediately followed.
"Then let's find another one!" The boss frowned and thought, but he still didn't know what to do.
"Let me ask Brother Hao Mei!" Liu Wei, the fourth child, always had simple ideas. He picked up his mobile phone and called Hao Mei.
When Wang Yue saw that he actually called Hao Mei, he knew that there might be a company dinner this time, so he quickly took out his mobile phone and made an appointment with Erxi.
After all, although Xiao Nai is evil, he is very good at being a good person. After all, this fox has been pretending to be human for so many years and has become a spirit long ago.
Sure enough, after a while Liu Wei cheerfully said that Hao Mei and the others were going to have dinner together, and had booked a private room in a hotel near the university town. It was said that the name of the private room was something that Xiao Nai was very satisfied with, and it was called Qingyun Pavilion.
A group of people rushed to the hotel. When Wang Yue saw the name of the private room opposite Qingyun Pavilion, the corners of his mouth twitched unconsciously, and he immediately understood why Xiao Nai was also there. This made Wang Yue learn again. This trick was so subtle that Wei Wei didn't think there was anything wrong in taking advantage of the situation.
At first, Wang Yue thought that Xiao Nai would ask Hao Mei to pay the bill and he would not come. However, he underestimated the extent of classmate Xiao Nai's conspiracy and his determination to protect his food.
After entering the box, while waiting for someone, Liu Weihe, the fourth child, and Juxuan, the eldest brother, were discussing about Juxuan on the opposite side.
Wang Yue went over and sat down, and heard that the fourth child was still giving the boss a detailed report of his Qianli Er income.
"Boss. I just heard that there was an offline gathering of a gang on the Imperial City Fengyun server across the street." Liu Wei, the fourth child, whispered to Huang Tao and Jia Honghai, as if he was afraid that the people opposite could hear it.
"That gang member?" Jia Honghai, the second oldest.
"I seem to have heard the number one beauty, Xiaoyu Yaoyao!" The fourth child just finished saying this, and Hao Mei immediately became excited when she heard the words Xiaoyu Yaoyao.
"What's wrong with Xiaoyu Yaoyao! I haven't played the game for a long time. What's new?"
"Xiaoyu Yaoyao is provoking the third sister-in-law again?"
"..."
A few people in the room who arrived early were quite excited. After all, she was the most beautiful woman in the game, but that was a photo, so what was the real situation?
"There is an offline party opposite A Chinese Ghost Story, and I heard someone say Xiaoyu Yaoyao." When Liu Wei saw the situation, he told everything he knew about the situation.
"I'll go listen!" As soon as Yu Banshan heard this, she opened the door and prepared to listen. As soon as he opened the door, he saw Xiao Nai preparing to open the door opposite!
"Third brother, I can't tell that you are such a third child. You already have junior sister Weiwei! Don't mess around with women." Hao Mei followed Yu Banshan.Behind him, there was an expression of hatred for steel.
